description: Source code for the Prospect doctype in ERPNext CRM module, including class definition and functions for converting prospects to customers and opportunities.

classes.name: Prospect
classes.description: Represents a Prospect document with methods to load contacts, validate, link with leads, and unlink dynamic links.

methods.name: onload
methods.description: Loads address and contact information when the Prospect document is loaded.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the Prospect document, updating lead details.

methods.name: on_update
methods.description: Links the prospect with lead contact and address upon update.

methods.name: on_trash
methods.description: Unlinks dynamic links when the Prospect document is deleted.

methods.name: update_lead_details
methods.description: Updates lead information in prospect lead rows.

methods.name: link_with_lead_contact_and_address
methods.description: Creates links between prospect and lead documents.

methods.name: unlink_dynamic_links
methods.description: Removes dynamic links associated with the prospect.
